config.idlefade.enable_fade.tooltip: Enable or disable idle fading for UI elements.
config.idlefade.tick_count_before_fade.t: How many ticks to wait before fading starts.
config.idlefade.fade_speed.tooltip: How quickly the UI fades. 100 must be divisible by this value (1, 2, 4, 5, 10, 20, 25, 50); otherwise, the fade will not work properly.
